title: Periods, prequantization, and rigidity in relative multisymplectic geometry
summary: Relative multisymplectic geometry replaces differential forms on a single manifold by cocycles in the mapping cone of a smooth map $F\colon M\to N$. Building on the relative Cartan calculus, the Lie $n$-algebras of relative observables, and the relative homotopy moment maps developed in companion work, we establish a range of applications showing that the framework is a working tool rather than a formal generalization.
